title: ReferenceList
description: v2 minimal flat shape: entries[] is the reference-asset array. Each entry is flat at top level. id, kind, and description are required in Phase 02. image_* fields are patched in Phase 03/05 for base references and keyframes. asset_* fields are patched in Phase 05 only for entries that require registration. keyframe entries add two first-class fields: for_segment and trigger.

id.description: Unique English snake_case id. Storyboard uses [[id]] references and references[].ref_id points here. The id itself must be self-descriptive, such as lin_yuan_office_white_blouse, and serves as a human-readable label.

kind.description: character / location / object are base types for Phase 02-03. keyframe is a refined first frame appended in Phase 05.

description.description: 1-3 sentences in the target language. Characters include appearance and physical state; locations include architecture/weather/light; objects include material/color/unique marks; keyframes state which segment they serve and why refinement is needed. Phase 03/05 turns this text into image_prompt.

image_url.description: Publicly accessible image URL. Patched in Phase 03 / 05.

image_prompt.description: Prompt text used by image-generation, with final line `Visual style: <visual_config.visual_style>`.

image_model.description: Actual image model used, such as seedream / banana / gpt-image-2.

asset_id.description: Asset id returned by register-asset; also the value passed to video-generation `ark_asset_ids`. Attach only for character/IP entries when the selected model requires registration.

asset_state.description: register-asset state. Entries that do not need registration should not carry asset_* fields.

for_segment.description: Keyframe-only: points to storyboard.segments[].id, indicating which segment this first frame serves.

trigger.description: Keyframe-only: reason that a synthesized first frame is needed.
